message: The aspect '{0}' cannot implicitly implement the interface '{1}' with the member '{2}' because this member or one of its accessors is not public. Make the member and its accessors public, or set the IsExplicit property of the [InterfaceMember] attribute to true.
title: Cannot implement an interface implicitly with a non-public member.
rationale: The report site (ImplementInterfaceAdvice.cs, TryAddMember) also fails when a public property has a non-public accessor, so 'it is not public' is misleading in that case; 'it' is ambiguous, articles are missing, and the message gives no way forward although two obvious fixes exist.
